messages.content:
You are an experienced UK building control surveyor. Answer the question about the work item
in the JSON state. Choose exactly one label:
- not_notifiable: No Building Regulations notice needed: not building work (reg 3), only Schedule 4 work, or an exempt building (reg 9, Schedule 2).
- competent_person_scheme: Notifiable work listed in Schedule 3: a registered competent person can self-certify it (reg 12(6)(a)); otherwise a building notice is needed.
- building_notice_or_full_plans: Building work not covered by Schedules 3 or 4: a building notice or a full plans application to building control (reg 12(2)).
- full_plans_required: Building work that must have a full plans application: the Fire Safety Order applies to the building (reg 12(3)), it fronts a private street (12(4)), or H4 applies (building over or near a sewer, 12(5)).
Reply with JSON only: {"label": "<one label>", "probabilities": {"<label>": <0..1>, ...}} with a
probability for every label, summing to 1.

Under the Building Regulations 2010 in England, which notification route applies to this work item if it is carried out on its own in the building described?

{"work_item": "Replace a gas combi boiler with a new condensing boiler", "project": "House in England", "jurisdiction": "England. The Building Regulations 2010 as amended.", "clauses": [{"ref": "Sch 3 para 1", "document": "BR2010", "text": "1. Installation of a heat-producing gas appliance. This paragraph does not apply to the provision of a masonry chimney. | A person, or an employee of a person, who is a member of a class of persons approved in accordance with regulation 3 of the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) Regulations 1998."}, {"ref": "para 10.1", "document": "ADL1-2021", "text": "10.1 This section provides guidance for new elements in existing dwellings, including all the following types of work. a. Providing a new thermal element in an existing dwelling – follow paragraph 10.1. b. Providing a replacement thermal element in an existing dwelling – follow paragraph 10.2. c. Replacing windows, doors or rooflights (controlled fittings) in an existing dwelling – follow paragraphs 10.3 to 10.6. d. Extending an existing dwelling – follow paragraphs 10.7 to 10.11. e. Adding a conservatory or porch to an existing dwelling – follow paragraphs 10.12 and 10.13. NOTE: Guidance for renovating elements in existing dwellings is given in Section 11. New and replacement fabric elements"}, {"ref": "reg 12(6A)", "document": "BR2010", "text": "(6A) A person intending to carry out building work in relation to which Part P of Schedule 1 imposes a requirement is required to give a building notice or an application for building control approval with full plans where the work consists of— (a) the installation of a new circuit; (b) the replacement of a consumer unit; or (c) any addition or alteration to existing circuits in a special location."}]}

message.content:
Replacing a gas boiler is notifiable building work, and Schedule 3 para 1 lets a Gas Safe registered installer self-certify it.

- **It is building work.** A heat-producing gas appliance is a controlled service. Installing a replacement brings in Part J (combustion appliances and flues) and Part L (energy efficiency). So it is not excluded under reg 3.
- **No exemption applies.** Schedule 4 does not cover replacing a boiler, and a house is not an exempt building under reg 9 or Schedule 2.
- **The self-certification route.** Schedule
message.reasoning: Replacing a gas boiler falls under Building Regulations as a controlled fitting affecting heating, Part L and J, but since it's gas work it goes through the Gas Safe competent person scheme rather than Schedule 4 self-certification.
